name: snapfind-ai
description: SnapFind AI — Scan. Find. Relive. Monorepo for photographer website, SnapFind web app, desktop app, and shared packages.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/tokens && npm run build --workspace=packages/ui && npm run build --workspace=packages/api-client
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/snapfind-web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:website && npm run build --workspace=apps/snapfind-web && npm run build --workspace=desktop
